author: blu
body: A bounded IntegerTy prints its bound. Dropping it emitted signatures whose stage-B guards and propagated param ranges silently vanished from the text round-trip - stage1 compiled with the parameters unbounded, which the CDX2051 promotion turned from a masked warning into a build failure. Full-range prints bare Integer, so unbounded signatures round-trip byte-identically.

author: blu
body: The row prints only at the arrow whose result it decorates: a tail merges into the result's effect bracket ([Audit, e]) or opens its own ([e]) when the result carries no concrete effects. An empty row prints nothing, so pure signatures are byte-identical to the pre-row rendering -- the text fixed point depends on this.

author: blu
body: A branch joins the group only when it carries the same non-negative alt-group as the group head: alternatives expanded from one source or-pattern share the head pattern's source offset, while distinct source arms (and synthesized arms, tagged -1) never re-merge even with identical bodies.
